Entry Maesters Maesters are trained by the Citadel, wear necklaces to symbolize different learnings, and serve the castle, lords and knowledge network. They handle letters, medicine, records, and advice, and are therefore often closer to power than people think; but whether their advice is heeded or not depends on the Lord. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
